title: Agent definition
description: The agent as code, in the format AZURE-AI-FOUNDRY-AGENTS.md §6 describes, extended with an `mcp` tool type (proposed back to the standard as E-2 in docs/DEVIATIONS.md). Strict: `additionalProperties` is false at every level, so a mistyped key is an error rather than a field a provisioner silently ignores. That strictness is the point — this file is behaviour with no code diff, and the edit that regresses an agent without anything going red is an edit to a key nobody validated.

slug.description: Stable identifier. Must match the directory this file lives in.

version.description: Moves with docs/SPEC.md. The Layer 1 baseline is recorded against a version, so a behaviour change that did not move this is a comparison across a measuring stick that changed length.

model.description: Explicitly nullable, and null means unchosen rather than default. A provisioner reading null MUST refuse; substituting a default is a behaviour change with no diff.

instructions.description: The system prompt. Under the change-coupling rule, editing this without touching docs/SPEC.md fails CI.

tools.description: An agent with no tools is a chat box, and this repository's whole subject is what happens when a model can act.

serverUrl.description: A placeholder, never a URL. A committed endpoint is a committed piece of somebody's infrastructure, and the substitution happens at provisioning time from the environment.

allowedTools.description: An allow-list, not a description. The validator checks it against the tool catalogue in the service's own source, so a tool added to the code without being added here is caught.

requireApproval.description: The read/write split from docs/SPEC.md §2.1, encoded where a provisioner can enforce it — a third layer, independent of the prompt and of the tool implementation.

metadata.description: Free-form by design, with five keys this repository treats as load-bearing. Additional keys are prose explaining a decision the format cannot express, which is where reasoning belongs when the artefact is JSON.

tier.description: AZURE-AI-FOUNDRY-AGENTS.md §6. Drives review depth and the eval gate this agent must clear.

specVersion.description: Checked against both `version` above and the specification document itself. Three places, one number, and CI is what keeps them the same number.
